2 Data import

gs <- "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1tCr3wBY-7dmV7rkXADhX12-drsYsfVziwbIzOJwGBco/edit?gid=654520959#gid=654520959" %>% 
  as_sheets_id()

fb <- gs %>% 
  range_read(ss = .,sheet = "papa") %>% 
  mutate(across(c(1:bloque), ~ as.factor(.))) 

fb %>% str()

3 Modelo

\[rendimiento = Bloque + V + R + V*R\]

av  <-  aov(rendimiento ~ bloque + variedad*riego, fb)

anova(av)

4 Multivariate

library(factoextra)

dtx <- fb %>%
  mutate(prod_planta = tuberculos * peso_tub) %>% 
  dplyr::select(c("variedad", "riego", "altura", "tuberculos", "peso_tub", "rendimiento", "materia_seca","prod_planta")) %>%
  group_by(variedad, riego) %>% 
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE))) %>% 
  unite("rowname", c("variedad", "riego"), remove = F, sep = "-") %>% 
  column_to_rownames() %>% 
  as.data.frame()

str(dtx)
'data.frame':   12 obs. of  8 variables:
 $ variedad    : Factor w/ 4 levels "Amarilis","Canchan",..: 1 1 1 2 2 2 3 3 3 4 ...
 $ riego       : Factor w/ 3 levels "50","75","100": 1 2 3 1 2 3 1 2 3 1 ...
 $ altura      : num  58.4 66.8 75.5 55.2 68.9 ...
 $ tuberculos  : num  9.23 10 13 8.6 12.63 ...
 $ peso_tub    : num  72.3 67.5 90.2 67.4 83 ...
 $ rendimiento : num  14.5 21.5 30.7 16.7 26.8 ...
 $ materia_seca: num  25.7 23.7 23 23.6 23.1 ...
 $ prod_planta : num  667 675 1172 578 1045 ...
mv <- dtx %>% 
  PCA(scale.unit = T
      , graph = F
      , quali.sup = c(1, 2))

var <- mv %>% 
  plot.PCA(choix = c("var"), cex=0.7)

var
cos <- mv %>% 
  fviz_pca_var(col.var = "cos2"
               , gradient.cols = inti:::paleta()
               , repel = TRUE
               , labelsize = 2)
cos
ind <- mv %>% 
  plot.PCA(choix = c("ind")
           , cex = 0.7
           , label = "ind"
           , invisible = "quali"
           , col.hab = inti:::paleta()
           , habillage = 2
           )

ind
pcainfo <- factoextra::get_pca(mv); pcainfo
